`TracyScoped.hpp` `tracy::ScopedZone` has only three constructors, and of those, only one of them takes a `const SourceLocationData*` The other two create the source location data and copy the strings. I suspect tracy expects the source information to be contiguous.  Inside `TracyProfiler.cpp` there is `AllocSourceLocation` which is used to allocate the memory.
